proof.machine: RTX PRO 6000 Blackwell 96 GB, shared; speech in its own process, Whisper large-v3 on the CPU

measured_with.words: faster-whisper large-v3, word error rate by our own Levenshtein

proof.note: Nobody has listened yet: every number was measured by a program.

source.about: an invented woman made with Wan 2.2, her voice Kokoro-82M's built-in bf_emma

music.about: an instrumental made here with MiniMax Music 3

voice.speaker: Ryan
voice.heard: Some places keep their secrets until the light is right. Tonight, the old harbor opens its doors and every lantern on the water tells a story of its own.

master.fault: The music measured 15.3 dB under the voice while it speaks, deeper than the 12 dB asked: the score is quieter in those stretches than on average.

clone.design: A warm, low-voiced adult man in his fifties, unhurried, a slight rasp, speaking close to the microphone.
clone.reference_line: Every morning the baker opens the blue door and sweeps the step before the street wakes up.
clone.line: The tide comes in twice a day, and twice a day the harbour remembers what it is for.
clone.heard: The tide comes in twice a day, and twice a day the harbor remembers what it is for.

consent.meaning: the reference voice was itself made by a model, so no real person's voice is copied
consent.designed_from: A warm, low-voiced adult man in his fifties, unhurried, a slight rasp, speaking close to the microphone.

clone.fault: Nothing measured wrong. Nobody has listened, and likeness is one encoder's opinion.

voice_dub.source_heard: We chart by the stars when the instruments go quiet. Tonight the sky is clear, the sea is clear,
voice_dub.translation: Navegamos por las estrellas cuando los instrumentos se callan. Esta noche el cielo está despejado.
voice_dub.translated_by: typed by hand (no local LLM was running)
voice_dub.model: Qwen3-TTS 1.7B Base, cloning the clip's voice
voice_dub.heard: es claro, navegamos por las estrellas cuando los instrumentos se caen. Esta noche el cielo está despejado.
voice_dub.fault: Whisper heard "es claro" before the line: the clone carried the tail of the source's half-finished sentence ("the sea is clear") into the new voice. The mouth still moves to the English words.

relip.translation: Navegamos por las estrellas cuando los instrumentos se callan. Esta noche el cielo está despejado.
relip.model: Qwen3-TTS 1.7B Base (clone) + LatentSync 1.6 through the Motion route
relip.heard: es claro, navegamos por las estrellas cuando los instrumentos se caen. Esta noche el cielo está despejado.
relip.fault: The same "es claro" carried over from the source sentence (it is in the voice, not the lips). LatentSync leaves the lower face a little softer than the rest of the frame, as on the Motion page.

dubit.fault: The voice is only a little like hers: likeness 0.63 to the source voice, against 0.87 for the Qwen3-TTS clone and about 0.60 for an unrelated stock voice. Curls of hair shift between frames. The sound comes out at -11.5 LUFS and -0.6 dBTP, unmastered.
